title: A sprint filed in a batch planning commit has its research story narrowed and its goal clauses mapped before the start gate is asked
goal: A sprint filed outside /kb-sprint plan (SP-4phd36pa was filed in the batch commit 0bcb147d2 with its start gate approved) reaches its start with plan step 1 (the research story's goal narrowed to the questions whose pack coverage is weak or none) and step 3 (each goal clause mapped to an item) done, or start warns that they were not: at SP-4phd36pa the orchestrator narrowed the goal itself at start.
notes: Filed as a retrospective draft at the SP-4phd36pa close; its check names a test not written yet (it collects none and fails until the work adds it), within the ceiling or merged into an existing test when planned. SP-ajcomz6d close (2026-10-11): the sprint again reached its start with the research goal not narrowed; the orchestrator ran the pack questions and narrowed it in the start commit.
